# dpnet_main.c guards its one-time init with InitOnceExecuteOnce.
remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600
    -DWINVER=0x600)

spec2def(dpnet.dll dpnet.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(dpnet registry dpnet.idl)

# dpnet.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dpnet-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dpnet_shims OBJECT address.c client.c dpnet_main.c lobbiedapp.c peer.c server.c threadpool.c)
target_link_libraries(dpnet_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libws2_32 libole32 libadvapi32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dpnet_shims)
add_dependencies(dpnet_shims wineheaders)
set(DPNET_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dpnet/dpnet_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dpnet dpnet-cargo dpnet.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dpnet_shims psdk dpnet_r ${DPNET_REUSED} uuid_sources)
